title: From Co-Writer to Co-Author? Investigating the Role of Generative AI in Student Scientific Writing

contributions.purpose: 论证生成式 AI 已从写作工具变为共同作者并识别两大核心挑战
contributions.mechanism: 概念分析:界定'AI as co-writer'对学生作者身份(epistemic agency)的侵蚀与公平风险(获取不均/认知外包/评估不透明)
contributions.evaluation: 定性论证,无实证数据;引 Kosmyna et al. 2025 EEG 研究的'cognitive debt'作为间接经验支撑
contributions.domain: 教育/AI 伦理(概念性论文)
contributions.source_quote: We identify two core challenges: (1) the erosion of traditional student authorship as AI systems shape the structure and content of scientific texts, and (2) emerging fairness risks related to unequal access, epistemic outsourcing, and opaque assessment.

contributions.purpose: 综述生成式 AI 与学生写作的跨领域文献
contributions.mechanism: 从 academic literacies/learning analytics/AI 伦理三线综合约 11 篇文献成对照表(Table 1)
contributions.evaluation: 定性综述;checklist 自承部分引用可能为幻觉,削弱可信度
contributions.source_quote: Drawing on recent literature from academic literacies, learning analytics, and AI ethics, we argue that large language models increasingly function not as passive tools but as co-writers.

contributions.purpose: 提出公平感知的 AI 写作整合框架
contributions.mechanism: 三支柱:批判性 AI 素养教学法+凸显学生推理的评估模式+透明可问责的 fairness-aware AI agent 设计
contributions.evaluation: 仅概念框架(Figure 1),未实现未验证
contributions.source_quote: We synthesize findings from empirical and theoretical studies and propose a framework for fairness-aware integration of AI into student writing.

self_declared_provenance.quote: Drawing on emerging literature from learning analytics, academic literacies, and science and technology studies, we explore how these AI systems challenge traditional notions of student authorship and call for a reconceptualization of fairness in academic writing.

notes: 概念性(非实证)社科论文,四元组 evaluation 格只能记定性论证,协议适配一般。AI 自我披露非常突出:(1) Paper Checklist 'Claims' 项自承'The abstract promises more scientific contribution than is actually presented in the paper'(自认摘要夸大贡献);(2) AI Involvement 'Observed AI Limitations' 自承'A high proportion of references were hallucinated or only loosely related',而正文 Limitations 节却称'we curated and verified all references',两处直接矛盾;(3) Author Contributions 明确 ChatGPT-4 生成并起草全部章节,人类(L.-M. Norz)仅监督/审校,分析与写作自评 [D]。格式问题:章节编号错乱(Section 3 标题'1 Academic Writing...'),Code of ethics/Broader impacts 以'概念论文'为由答 NA 属答非所问。无编号贡献列表,由 abstract+conclusion 归纳 3 条。
